title: Lemonade Stand Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Lemonade Stand is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 2048 E County Hwy 30-A Lemonade Stand | Seaside, Florida Gulf-view coastal retreat with six bedrooms and private beach accessPrime Seaside Location Near Odessa PavilionLemonade Stand is a beautifully appointed beachside cottage located in the heart of Seaside, Florida. The home offers an exceptional location just steps from the private residential beach access at Odessa Pavilion, a short walk to the West Pool, and minutes from Seaside’s town center, dining, and shopping. With Gulf views and walkable access to Seaside’s most sought-after amenities, this home is ideal for families and groups.Arrival & First Floor LayoutGuests are welcomed by a spacious front deck that sets the tone for relaxed coastal living. The entire first floor is dedicated to sleeping accommodations, offering four bedrooms—each with a private ensuite bathroom.Two south-side king suites provide comfortable retreats, with one suite featuring bathroom grab bars at both the toilet and shower for added accessibility. On the north side of the home are two twin bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combination, making them well suited for children or adults.Also on the first floor is a foyer and media area, furnished with a sofa, two club chairs, a mounted flat-screen TV, and a stereo soundbar—an ideal space for movie nights or relaxing between beach outings.Second Floor Living Areas with Gulf ViewsThe second floor opens to a bright, open-concept living space with breathtaking Gulf views and abundant natural light. The living room offers comfortable seating, high ceilings, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Nearby, a card table provides a dedicated space for games, while the dining area comfortably seats eight guests for shared meals.The adjacent kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, a five-burner electric cooktop, and a large Sub-Zero refrigerator. A breakfast bar with seating for four adds additional casual dining space.Outdoor Living & Open-Air PorchesOutdoor living is a standout feature of Lemonade Stand. On the Gulf-facing side of the second floor, an open-air porch features Adirondack bar seating for four, creating the perfect vantage point for morning coffee, sunset views, and panoramic Gulf scenery.At the front of the home, an additional spacious porch offers alfresco dining for eight, allowing guests to enjoy meals outdoors in the coastal breeze.Second Floor BedroomsAlso located on the second floor are two additional bedrooms:Primary King Suite: This spacious retreat includes built-in closets, a dedicated desk for remote work, and an ensuite bathroom with a deep soaking tub, walk-in shower, and single vanity.Queen Bedroom: This bedroom features a custom-built queen bed and a full bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Thoughtful Design for Group StaysWith six bedrooms, including three king suites, and six full bathrooms, Lemonade Stand is thoughtfully designed for larger families or group getaways. The home’s generous indoor living spaces, expansive outdoor porches, Gulf views, and prime Seaside location make it an exceptional choice for a relaxed yet refined beach vacation.* 5-night minimum for Spring, Spring Break, and Summer. 3-night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,622 square feet of living spaceLocated approximately 66 feet / a 1-minute walk to the beachAccess to the private Seaside residential beach at Odessa Pavilion; Seaside offers one of the largest private residential beaches on 30APrivate off-street parking in driveways for two vehiclesStackable washer and dryerEnclosed outdoor showerAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, and three pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at Seaside TransitPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedGolf carts are considered vehicles; non-homeowner golf carts are prohibited in Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets permitted
